guard: a frame marks the sender's self-written name and role as unverified
why: The suite imports the connector-core source directly, so no rebuild is needed for those entries.
Every surface renders the sender through `fmtFrom`, so one mutation there reaches the wake
label, the preview rows, the injected block and the cotal_inbox reply together.
The quote scrub lives in core's `peerLabel`, which connector-core reads from the built `dist`,
so that entry rebuilds core before the suite and again after the restore.
